services.title: Income Tax Return Filing
services.heroSubtitle: Filing an Income Tax Return (ITR) is one of the most important compliance requirements under the Income Tax Act, 1961. It enables individuals, businesses, and other entities to report their income, claim eligible deductions, pay applicable taxes, and maintain compliance with tax regulations. A correctly filed return not only helps avoid penalties and legal complications but also serves as an important financial document for loan applications, visa processing, government tenders, and other financial transactions.
services.introDescription: At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive Income Tax Return Filing services for individuals, businesses, and various types of entities. Our professionals ensure accurate tax computation, timely filing, proper disclosure of income, and compliance with the latest tax provisions. Whether your income includes salary, business profits, capital gains, rental income, or other sources, we simplify the entire filing process while helping you maximise eligible tax benefits and minimise compliance risks.

services.title: TDS/TCS Compliance
services.heroSubtitle: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) are important compliance requirements under the Income Tax Act, applicable to businesses, employers, professionals, and certain individuals. These provisions ensure timely collection of taxes by requiring tax to be deducted or collected at the time of specified transactions. Failure to comply with TDS/TCS provisions can result in interest, penalties, disallowance of expenses, and notices from the Income Tax Department.
services.introDescription: At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive TDS and TCS compliance services to help businesses meet their statutory obligations with accuracy and confidence. From tax deduction and return filing to reconciliation and compliance advisory, our professionals ensure every aspect of TDS/TCS is handled efficiently and within the prescribed timelines.

services.title: Advance Tax Computation
services.heroSubtitle: Advance Tax is the income tax payable in installments during the financial year instead of a single payment at the end of the year. It is applicable to taxpayers whose estimated tax liability exceeds the prescribed threshold under the Income Tax Act, 1961. Accurate computation of advance tax is essential to avoid interest under Sections 234B and 234C, ensure timely compliance, and effectively manage cash flow.
services.introDescription: At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive Advance Tax Computation services for individuals, professionals, businesses, LLPs, companies, and other taxable entities. Our professionals carefully estimate your annual tax liability, reconcile available tax credits, and prepare a structured payment plan to help you remain fully compliant while avoiding unnecessary interest and penalties.

services.title: Income Computation & Disclosure Standards (ICDS)
services.heroSubtitle: Income Computation and Disclosure Standards (ICDS) are a set of tax accounting standards notified by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) under the Income Tax Act, 1961. These standards prescribe the manner in which certain categories of income and expenses should be recognised for the purpose of computing taxable income. ICDS generally applies to taxpayers following the mercantile system of accounting and is intended to bring uniformity and consistency in tax reporting.
services.introDescription: Improper application of ICDS may result in tax adjustments, scrutiny assessments, additional tax liabilities, and prolonged litigation. At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive ICDS advisory services to help businesses understand the applicability of these standards, align their accounting practices with tax requirements, and ensure accurate computation of taxable income.
